params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Required. The name of the device. For example, projects/p0/locations/us-central1/registries/registry0/devices/device0 or projects/p0/locations/us-central1/registries/registry0/devices/{num_id}.

params.name: data.field_mask
params.description: The fields of the Device resource to be returned in the response. If the field mask is unset or empty, all fields are returned. Fields have to be provided in snake_case format, for example: last_heartbeat_time.
